contracts.borrowed_decision_structure: Borrow temporal/multi-hop/adversarial memory outcomes, answer-turn provenance and retrieval-noise controls; do not call M2A's derived dataset the same revision.
contracts.strongest_transfer_failure: Caption substitution means most memory QA evidence is not a causal test of visual-memory necessity; the synthetic generation pipeline also limits ecological validity.
contracts.rejection_observation: Matched speech/omni arm shows no task-grounded effect or violates the declared access contract.

contracts.borrowed_decision_structure: Borrow no/retrieval, text-versus-multimodal evidence, and k-budget arms; ScienceQA/VQA values are not portable to speech/omni.
contracts.strongest_transfer_failure: Retrieved answer-bearing exemplars, text-only strength, and dataset-specific library construction leave answer leakage and modality-necessity alternatives unresolved.
contracts.rejection_observation: Matched speech/omni arm shows no task-grounded effect or violates the declared access contract.

contracts.borrowed_decision_structure: Borrow trigger/no-trigger, focused observation, candidate actions, visual history, aggregation, budget and repair-success arms.
contracts.strongest_transfer_failure: The static setting uses a VLM judge as trigger and reports substantial inference overhead; reward is not independently calibrated.
contracts.rejection_observation: Matched speech/omni arm shows no task-grounded effect or violates the declared access contract.

contracts.borrowed_decision_structure: Borrow full-information ceiling, partial-information active acquisition, question utility and stop-timing diagnostics.
contracts.strongest_transfer_failure: Synthetic images/captions and an external answer source create a game-like protocol; question asking is not equivalent to audio-tool use or reward-guided control.
contracts.rejection_observation: Matched speech/omni arm shows no task-grounded effect or violates the declared access contract.

contracts.borrowed_decision_structure: Borrow zero-shot, CoT, Best-of-N, self-consistency, self-refinement and beam arms plus external/internal verifier separation.
contracts.strongest_transfer_failure: Methods, models and verifier access vary across cells; the paper is a directional falsifier, not a pooled universal effect estimate.
contracts.rejection_observation: Matched speech/omni arm shows no task-grounded effect or violates the declared access contract.

contracts.borrowed_decision_structure: Borrow extraction/adaptation, reasoning, knowledge-update/conflict/refusal and text-versus-multimodal strata.

contracts.borrowed_decision_structure: Borrow query-only, passive-retrieval and oracle-memory arms plus tool/argument and retrieved-but-unused diagnostics.
contracts.strongest_transfer_failure: The generated text-only task is not a speech/omni reproduction target; oracle retrieval changes evidence availability rather than only memory policy.
contracts.rejection_observation: Matched speech/omni arm shows no task-grounded effect or violates the declared access contract.

contracts.borrowed_decision_structure: Borrow raw-versus-semantic store, text/image retrieval, iterative refinement and modality ablations; enhanced LoCoMo is not the project's speech task.
contracts.strongest_transfer_failure: The full system changes storage, retrieval, iteration and modality together; automatic judges and the derived dataset limit clean attribution and cross-paper numeric comparison.
contracts.rejection_observation: Matched speech/omni arm shows no task-grounded effect or violates the declared access contract.

contracts.borrowed_decision_structure: Borrow fixed-task paired trials, deterministic verifiers, multiple harnesses, invocation-rate audit, compactness ablations and negative-task analysis.
contracts.strongest_transfer_failure: Skill injection adds context; no matched-length random/irrelevant/source-document control fully isolates procedural structure, and harness choice materially changes the effect.
contracts.rejection_observation: Matched speech/omni arm shows no task-grounded effect or violates the declared access contract.

contracts.borrowed_decision_structure: Borrow experience-versus-skill factorial arms, transfer across agent backbones and Average@4/Pass@4; visual-tool tasks are not target speech reproduction.
contracts.strongest_transfer_failure: Ground-truth answers are used during training-split accumulation and critique; frozen core therefore does not mean absence of supervised external learning.
contracts.rejection_observation: Matched speech/omni arm shows no task-grounded effect or violates the declared access contract.

contracts.borrowed_decision_structure: Borrow learn/prime-interfere-test timing, first-attempt scoring and procedural-memory versus skill distinction.
contracts.strongest_transfer_failure: Text-only, within-context exposure may be in-context learning rather than durable memory; automatic judges are used for some constructs.
contracts.rejection_observation: Matched speech/omni arm shows no task-grounded effect or violates the declared access contract.

contracts.borrowed_decision_structure: Borrow sequential family-local evaluation, empty-library baseline, raw-history control, cost and library-health measures, and negative-transfer audit.
contracts.strongest_transfer_failure: Incorrect skills propagate error, skill inflation can reduce performance, and library repair—not creation alone—appears to govern benefit.
contracts.rejection_observation: Matched speech/omni arm shows no task-grounded effect or violates the declared access contract.

contracts.borrowed_decision_structure: Borrow oracle-skill, retrieval, loading and hard-negative decomposition to measure selection utility separately from task success.
contracts.strongest_transfer_failure: High retrieval recall or skill loading does not imply correct incorporation or downstream utility; this directly blocks retrieval-quality-to-capability inference.
contracts.rejection_observation: Matched speech/omni arm shows no task-grounded effect or violates the declared access contract.

contracts.strongest_transfer_failure: Vision-language entity QA is not a speech task; retrieval and reasoning interventions may change together in the agentic arm.
contracts.rejection_observation: Matched speech/omni arm shows no task-grounded effect or violates the declared access contract.

contracts.rejection_observation: Matched speech/omni arm shows no task-grounded effect or violates the declared access contract.
